name: PlebX Social Overlay
summary: Middleware overlay that turns Plebbit (5chan) content into a Twitter/Meet.me-style social experience with ranked feeds, profiles, chat, and image support.
goals: Expose a Twitter-like ranked feed from Plebbit content
Provide profiles, follow/friend relationships, chat/messaging and image uploads
Keep Plebbit federation intact by default (read-only ingestion)
Create a scaffold that can be hardened and scaled to production
primary_features: Threaded comments with click-through thread view
Image upload and preview with NSFW scanning
secondary_features: Optional write-back to Plebbit after moderation
Personalization with embeddings and vector DB
security_considerations: Read-only ingestion by default to avoid upstream side effects
NSFW and malware scanning for images
PII detection and masking before using external APIs
Audit logs for all agent actions
